Concert Transportation Phoenix: Skip the Traffic & Parking

Nothing ruins a concert like spending an hour in the parking lot. Professional transportation transforms the entire concert experience—from pre-show excitement to post-show convenience.

Why Concert Transportation Makes Sense

  • Skip parking chaos - Drop-off at the door
  • Pre-game properly - Drinks aboard are for guests 21 and over only (BYOB; we do not sell alcohol)
  • No designated driver - Everyone enjoys the show
  • Beat the exit rush - Priority pickup spots
  • Keep the party going - Post-concert dinner plans

Phoenix Concert Venues

Footprint Center (Downtown)

  • Capacity: 18,000
  • Parking: $20-40
  • Exit time: 45-90 minutes
  • Our drop-off: Jefferson Street

Ak-Chin Pavilion (West Phoenix)

  • Capacity: 20,000
  • Parking: $25-50
  • Exit time: 60-120 minutes
  • Our drop-off: VIP entrance

Arizona Financial Theatre

  • Capacity: 5,000
  • Parking: $15-30
  • Exit time: 30-45 minutes
  • Our drop-off: Front entrance

State Farm Stadium (Glendale)

  • Capacity: 63,000
  • Parking: $40-60
  • Exit time: 90-180 minutes
  • Our drop-off: Gate entrance

Vehicle Recommendations

Small Groups (2-4)

Luxury SUV (Suburban), up to 6

  • $125/hour, 4-hour minimum
  • Perfect for couples or double dates
  • Intimate pre and post-show

Medium Groups (6-10)

Chrysler Limo (up to 8) or Executive Black Sprinter (up to 14)

  • $150/hour or $145/hour, 4-hour minimum
  • Space to get ready en route
  • Celebration atmosphere

Large Groups (12-25)

Party Bus (28 Pax)

  • $250/hour, 4-hour minimum
  • Full party experience
  • Dance floor and sound system

Concert Night Timeline

5:30 PM - Pickup from first location
6:00 PM - Quick dinner stop (optional)
6:45 PM - Arrive at venue for drinks
7:30 PM - Find seats, opening act
10:30 PM - Show ends
10:35 PM - Text driver, immediate pickup
11:00 PM - Post-concert meal
12:30 AM - Return home

Pro Tips

  1. Book the opener - Arrive for the whole show
  2. Pack snacks - Concert food is overpriced
  3. Wear comfortable shoes - Even with transportation
  4. Charge your phone - Our vehicles have outlets
  5. Have a meeting spot - Where to find the driver

Compare to Alternatives

Rideshare at a Major Concert

  • Surge pricing: 3-5x normal rates
  • Wait time: 45-90 minutes
  • Split up groups
  • Total: $80-200+ per person

Our Service

  • Fixed price confirmed
